title: Correct emf
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the equivalent emf ε0 as 3 V.

title: Correct resistance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the internal resistance r as 4.8 Ω.

title: Correct short-circuit current
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately find the short-circuit current I as 0.625 A.

title: Use of Thévenin's theorem
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of Thévenin's theorem in their reasoning.

title: Parallel resistance calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for calculating parallel resistances.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Sign errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in calculations of voltage and current.

title: Missing factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing any factors in the resistance calculations.
